name: Epokasite Fixer
body:
EPOKASITE FIXER
CR 3

XP 800
N Tiny fey
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +10
Aura draining (20 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+2 size, +3 Dex)
hp 27 (5d6+5+5)
Fort +2, Ref +7, Will +5

Defensive Abilities tech resistance 5; Resist electricity 5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee +2 rapier +5 (1d3+1 P, 18–20/×2)
Ranged +2 shortbow +5 (1d3+2/×3 P, range incr. 60 ft.)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks anachronistic strikes (+2)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 1st, concentration +1)

At will—mending
1/day—detect radiation, hold portal, technomancy

STATISTICS

Str 8 (–1); Dex 16 (+3); Con 12 (+1); Int 18 (+4); Wis 12 (+1); Cha 10 (+0)
Base Atk +2; CMB +3; CMD +12
Feats Point-Blank Shot, Toughness, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +11, Disable Device +8, Fly +23, Intimidate +5, Knowledge (engineering) +9, Knowledge (history) +13, Knowledge (local) +12, Perception +10, Sleight of Hand +11, Stealth +19; Species Modifiers +4 Knowledge (history)
Languages Common, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Anachronistic Strikes (Su)

Any mundane weapon wielded by an epokasite is treated as if it were magic and cold iron for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction.

Weapons wielded by epokasites typically deal additional damage or have additional weapon properties. These properties only function when the weapon is wielded by the epokasite.

Draining Aura (Su)

An epokasite fixer radiates an aura that drains active technological items. While in the area, all technological items that use charges to function require 1 additional charge per use, reduce the saving throw DCs of any effects they create by 2, and increase the DC of all checks to use the item by 2.

Tech Resistance (Su)

An epokasite naturally resists technology, including most synthetic and technological weapons, spells cast by technomancers, technological traps, hybrid techno-magic gear, and the natural attacks of robots and other technological creatures. Any damage the epokasite takes from such sources is reduced by the listed amount (minimum 0), which doesn’t stack with other resistances the epokasite has. Natural hazards, mundane weapons, and other forms of magic bypass this defense.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary or reenactment (2–7)
Treasure standard (shortbow with 20 arrow, rapier, masterwork thieves’ tools, other treasure)

Epokasites are fey who take an obsessive interest in humanoid culture. They consider themselves preservers of specific historical eras, fixating on fashion, technology, and customs from their chosen time period to the exclusion of all else.

Epokasites limits themselves to clothing and gear appropriate to their chosen time period—whether that be a medieval squire’s doublet, a diesel mechanic’s denim coveralls and thick goggles, or an early fusion-age starship pilot’s one-piece primary color jumpsuit.

The two most common varieties of epokasites are the fixers, why stand only about a foot tall, and the runners, who are five feet tall on average. The shy fixers usually operate from the shadows, observing but rarely interacting with humanoids directly. Runners, on the other hand, are more outgoing—the enjoy living openly among humanoids and discussing the time periods they love. Some even work as historians, historical reenactors, or consultants.

Epokasites are extremely long-lived and most become attached to the time period that they first came into existence on the Material Plane, although some take an interest in older periods. Whatever period they attach to, their obsession runs deep.

They often feel that modern technology has taken a turn for the worse, and they may take steps to sabotage it—perhaps sneaking into a laboratory, factory, or starship in order to make mischief.
